This '''trial''' began in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] when the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] arrested former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]] for her [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] at the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

===The trial===
{{Quote|I promise you that I will find her the best, most decent, most honest, hardest working lawyer I can.''"<br />"''Oh. I was trying to get her someone who'd win.|Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo, on finding a lawyer to represent Tahiri Veila|<ref name="Allies" />}}
====Arrest and Court of Jedi Affairs====
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] arrested former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]] for the [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] during the [[Second Battle of Fondor]] in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

She was brought to trial in the [[Court of Jedi Affairs]], where Galactic Alliance [[Judge/Legends|Judge]] [[Arabelle Lorteli]] presided over the case. Lorteli prohibited the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] [[Nawara Ven]] from continuing to aid Veila in the case as he had in a [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Tahiri Veila|previous trial]].<ref name="Abyss" /> Ven's role was briefly filled by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Mardek Mool]]. However, after Mool tried to act as an intermediary for [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]], offering Veila a deal to drop the charges in exchange for her spying on the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]], Veila fired him.<ref name="Backlash" />

====Dissolution of the Jedi Court and return to Court of Justice====
Veila's friend, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], asked [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]] to find her a decent lawyer, and he arranged for the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]], uncle of the Galactic Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]], to assist Veila. The [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] lawyer [[Sul Dekkon]] represented the Galactic Alliance in the case, and after Lorteli was dismissed from duty by Daala, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] Judge [[Mavari Zudan]] presided over the trial.<ref name="Allies" />

With Bwua'tu as her lawyer, Veila began to make progress in the court. However, an audio recording was eventually recovered of her final conversation with Pellaeon right before she killed him, again turning the jury against her.<ref name="Allies" /> Meanwhile, after an [[Attempted assassination of Admiral Nek Bwua'tu|attack]] on Nek Bwua'tu left the Admiral in a coma, Veila began to fear that Eramuth was too distracted to properly carry out her defense, and, despite Eramuth's insistence to the contrary, took on the support of an additional lawyer, [[Sardonne Sardon]]. Bwua'tu attempted to withdraw from the case, but Judge Zudan denied him; Bwua'tu then became increasingly disinterested in the trial. However, Veila realized that she fared better in her case with just Bwua'tu supporting her than she did with Bwua'tu and Sardon, she eventually decided to fire the latter.<ref name="Vortex" />

Soon afterward, the Jedi Order [[Plan Delta|ousted]] Daala from her position as Chief of State and a [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] including [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]] took control of the Galactic Alliance. Nevertheless, the Jedi's influence was not enough to drop the charges against Veila; to the contrary, suspecting that the Jedi were trying to permanently take over the Alliance, the jury became biased against Veila and found her guilty despite the revelation that practically all the prosecution's evidence had been tampered with in some form. Veila was sentenced to death, and she was stationed in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]], along with the deposed Daala. Before long, however, Veila [[Escape from the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|escaped]] the prison with Daala when the former Chief of State arranged for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to break her free.<ref name="Conviction" />
